scoring_justification: Magnetic data checked via result-level compare (T0) with paper gold using tolerances; optical spectra checked via structural audit (T3) of ε2 peak presence and suppression, as full optical recompute not feasible in verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for magnetic data and structural thresholds for optical spectra
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from paper Table 1 (ΔE=0.255 eV, magnetic moments 4 μB, 2.14 μB) and text (optical peak at 1.36 eV, amplitude >0.3, suppressed under GGA+U).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Since the paper reports these numeric results, the gold is taken verbatim; the structural thresholds are based on the described peak energies and qualitative suppression behavior.

outputs.description: Extracted total-energy difference and magnetic moments for the V-doped configuration I.
Optical spectra (dielectric function and absorption) computed with GGA and GGA+U.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify the magnetic data against paper‑reported reference values with appropriate tolerances, and will perform a structural audit on the optical spectra to confirm the characteristic GGA low‑energy peak and its suppression under GGA+U.
